便于你之后找到这组稿件: A name to help you find these drafts later
例如：产品介绍、功能事实、已有草稿。可粘贴文字或上传文本文件。: For example: a product description, verified features, or an existing draft. Paste text or upload a text file.
这是什么产品？有哪些有依据的事实和重点？: What is the product? Which facts and key points can you substantiate?
例如：解释新功能、分享实践经验，或介绍产品解决的问题。: For example: explain a new feature, share practical experience, or describe the problem your product solves.
例如：正在搭建 AI Agent 的开发者；说明他们的背景或困扰。: For example: developers building AI agents. Describe their background or challenges.
本次试运行预设：LinkedIn、中文和英文、普通动态。可以修改；这不是全局默认: This trial is preset to LinkedIn, Chinese and English, and feed posts. You can change these selections; they are not global defaults.
仅平台 × 语言拆稿：当前 {count} 份。其他选项合并到每份稿件。: Only platform × language creates separate drafts: {count} selected. Other settings apply within each draft.

平台、语言或格式未选；默认值尚未确定，请先配置本次试稿。: A platform, language, or format is missing. No default has been set; choose the settings for this trial first.
自由补充品牌语气、需要解释的术语等，不增加稿件数量。: Add brand voice notes or terms to explain. This does not create more drafts.
提供希望参考的结构或语气: Share the structure or voice you want to draw on
本阶段尚不读取链接，请粘贴正文或上传 .txt / .md 文本。: URL reading is not available in this stage. Paste the content or upload a .txt / .md file.
未选用配图时会请求自动配图。上传支持 PNG / JPEG；本轮 LinkedI: With no images selected, automatic image generation will be requested. Uploads support PNG / JPEG; this stage supports one image per LinkedIn post.
生成结果仅暂存。点击右侧“确认保存此版本”才会进入正式作品库。: Generated content stays in temporary storage. Click “Confirm and save this version” to add it to your saved library.
按当前左侧资料重新生成: Retry with the current writing brief
填写左侧三项资料，生成后可切换中英文、直接编辑段落，也可以选中文字提交修改意见。: Complete the three required fields on the left. After generation, switch between Chinese and English drafts, edit paragraphs, or select text to request a revision.
初稿 · 一次自动审核 · 修订稿: First draft · One automatic review · Revised draft
正在查看历史版本。开始新修订将从最新正式版本创建暂存，不从当前历史版本派生。: You are viewing an earlier version. A new revision starts from the latest saved version, not the historical version shown here.
已正式保存。继续修改将从当前最新正式版本创建暂存，保留旧版。: Saved to the library. Further edits will start a temporary revision of the latest saved version; earlier versions are preserved.
此暂存在恢复备份前创建，不能直接覆盖恢复后的数据。: This temporary draft predates a backup restore and cannot overwrite the restored data.
此暂存已经确认，不能再直接修改。: This draft has already been confirmed and cannot be edited directly.
当前稿件与服务器版本冲突。你的编辑仍保留，自动暂存已暂停。: This draft conflicts with the server version. Your edits are preserved and automatic saving is paused.
保留当前编辑，派生为新作品: Keep edits as a new work
文本流程已完成，自动配图未连接；本稿没有自动生成的图片。: The text workflow is complete. Image generation is not connected, so no image was generated for this draft.
选中文字，提出局部修改: Select text to request a revision
在上方某个段落内拖选文字。未选中的文字和其他段落保持不变。: Select text within a paragraph above. Unselected text and other paragraphs will stay unchanged.
例如：用更直接的措辞，保留事实和数字。: For example: make the wording more direct while keeping the facts and figures.
预览提案全文。接受后仍是暂存，尚未正式保存。: Preview the proposed draft below. Accepting it keeps it in temporary storage; it is not yet saved to the library.
源稿已经修改，此提案不能再接受。请放弃并重新发起。: The source draft has changed, so this proposal can no longer be accepted. Discard it and request a new one.
确认保存只保存本机版本，不会发布。: Confirming saves a local version only. It does not publish.
确认保存的作品会出现在这里，发布页只读取这些正式版本。: Confirmed content appears here. The publishing page only uses these saved versions.
核对版本，再确认发布。: Check the version, then confirm publication.
这里只使用已确认保存的正式版本。发布需要单独确认。: Only confirmed, saved versions are used here. Publishing requires a separate confirmation.

此平台的发布入口尚未接入，不能提交或返回发布结果。: Publishing is not connected for this platform. Posts cannot be submitted and no publishing result is available.
先在本机服务端配置 OAuth 应用: Configure an OAuth application on the local server first
由维护者按项目说明设置应用配置，重新启动服务后刷新。密钥不在页面输入，也不进入备: Ask the maintainer to configure the application using the project instructions, restart the service, and refresh. Secrets are not entered on this page or included in backups.
应用需启用 LinkedIn 登录和 Share on LinkedIn，并取得: The application needs LinkedIn sign-in, Share on LinkedIn, and permission to publish personal posts. A successful connection does not enable native Pulse articles.
回调地址须与 LinkedIn 应用后台完全一致。实际 OAuth 授权在 Li: The callback URL must exactly match the LinkedIn application settings. OAuth authorization takes place on LinkedIn's official website.
还没有正式 LinkedIn 作品。先在创作页确认保存一份稿件。: There is no saved LinkedIn content yet. Confirm and save a draft on the Create page first.
当前仅支持 LinkedIn 普通 feed 动态；原生 Pulse 长文或混合: Only LinkedIn feed posts are currently supported. Native Pulse articles and mixed formats cannot be published.
选定正式版本和已连接账号后，生成可确认的发布预览。: Choose a saved version and a connected account to prepare a preview for confirmation.
正式版本正文（尚未核对发布）: Saved content (not yet checked for publishing)
确认有效期至 {date}；账号或正式版本变化后需重新预览。: Confirmation expires at {date}. Prepare a new preview after changing the account or saved version.
预览已过期，请重新核对发布预览。: This preview has expired. Prepare and check a new publishing preview.
我已核对以上正文、图片、语言与账号，确认将此正式版本发布到 LinkedIn。: I have checked the text, images, language, and account above, and confirm publishing this saved version to LinkedIn.
目前没有发布记录。: There are no publishing records yet.
平台结果未知。不要重新发帖；先在平台核对。只有已知平台 ID 的记录才能查询结果: The platform result is unknown. Do not post again; check the platform first. Results can only be queried when a platform ID is known.
平台已返回成功，暂未提供可用链接。: The platform reported success, but has not provided a usable link.
恢复前的暂存 · 本地修改已保留，请派生新暂存: Draft predates restore · Edits preserved; create a new temporary draft
备份已恢复，请从作品库重新打开正式版本: Backup restored. Reopen a saved version from the content library.
请先处理版本冲突或派生新的暂存。: Resolve the version conflict or create a new temporary draft first.
仍有新修改等待暂存: New edits are still waiting to be saved
暂存失败，修改仍在当前页面: Temporary save failed; your edits remain on this page
数据已恢复，请重新打开暂存。当前编辑仍保留。: Data was restored. Reopen the temporary draft; your current edits are preserved.
有修改等待暂存: Edits are waiting to be saved
资料与参考文件当前只支持 .txt / .md，请先转换为文本文件。: Materials and reference files currently support only .txt / .md. Convert the file to text first.
配图当前支持 PNG、JPEG。: Images currently support PNG and JPEG.
请填写产品资料／已有内容、写作目的、目标读者；资料也可上传 .txt / .md: Provide product materials or existing content, a writing goal, and target readers. You can upload materials as .txt / .md files.

源稿在提案期间已修改。请放弃此提案，再选择文字发起修改。: The source draft changed while this proposal was being prepared. Discard it, select text, and request a new revision.

授权地址不是 LinkedIn 官方地址，已停止跳转。: The authorization URL is not an official LinkedIn address. Navigation was stopped.
